_doc: Kill-switch. paused=true → Maker IDLE. Checker only runs WATCHDOG recovery when by=deploy-watchdog; otherwise Checker IDLEs too.

_last_incident.what: Checker lane deadlocked 2026-08-07..09 across four repos. locks.json lease.pr held a full URL; the dispatcher did Number(lease.pr) → NaN, and NaN !== 15 is true, so the oldest open PR always looked superseded. decideChecker tests CLOSE_STALE before REVIEW, so every tick proposed closing a healthy PR; the Checker agent correctly refused at the playbook gate and stopped, never reaching REVIEW.
_last_incident.fix: lease.pr normalized to integers here; durable fix (parse number/string/URL, and treat unparseable as NOT superseded) landed in ai-dev-methodologies and arrives on next methodology sync.
_last_incident.verified: ViOS merged its first queued PR on the next Checker tick after the same fix.
_last_incident.note_for_this_repo: This repo also showed the Maker going quiet after 2026-08-07, which the other three did not. If no Maker activity resumes within a day of this unpause, that is a SECOND, separate fault — investigate the Maker automation itself, not the Checker.
